// Code generated by skgo. DO NOT EDIT.
import { command, query } from '$app/server';
import type { Todo } from '../../lib/skgo/businesslogic/types';
import type { Rename, Retitle } from './types';

export type { Rename, Retitle, Todo };

// Every body throws. These functions are implemented in Go, and skgo
// answers their endpoints itself, so anything that renders in the browser
// is proof the Go handler replied rather than this module.
const unimplemented = (): never => {
	throw new Error('skgo: implemented in Go');
};

export const addTodo = command('unchecked', (_arg: string): Todo => unimplemented());

export const getTodo = query('unchecked', (_arg: string): Todo => unimplemented());

export const getTodos = query((): Array<Todo> => unimplemented());

export const renameTodo = command('unchecked', (_arg: Rename): Todo => unimplemented());

export const retitleTodo = command('unchecked', (_arg: Retitle): Todo => unimplemented());

export const watchCount = query.live((): AsyncIterable<number> => unimplemented());

===== BEGIN EXCERPT origin: example/web/src/routes/actions/+page.server.ts lines 1-29 =====
// Code generated by skgo. DO NOT EDIT.
import { building } from '$app/env';
import type { Money } from '../../hooks';
import type { Profile } from './types';

// The body throws. This load is implemented in Go, and skgo answers
// __data.json itself, so anything that renders in the browser is proof the
// Go handler replied rather than this module. Kit normally reads the export
// only to learn that the route has server data. Its prerenderer does call it,
// which is refused until Go loads can run during a build (#81).
const unimplemented = (route: string): never => {
	if (building) throw new Error('skgo: route ' + route + ' is prerendered, and its branch has a Go server load at ' + "src/routes/actions/page.server.go" + '; skgo cannot answer a load while kit prerenders (#81). Remove the prerender or move the load');
	throw new Error('skgo: implemented in Go');
};

export const load = (event: { url: URL }): { profile: Profile; actionCookie: string } => unimplemented(event.url.pathname);

// Kit reads these exports for action typing; Go answers every submission.
export const actions = {
	archive: async (_event: { request: Request }): Promise<void> => { throw new Error('skgo: action implemented in Go'); },
	forbidden: async (_event: { request: Request }): Promise<void> => { throw new Error('skgo: action implemented in Go'); },
	inspect: async (_event: { request: Request }): Promise<{ interests: Array<string>; submitter: string; encoding: string; price: Money }> => { throw new Error('skgo: action implemented in Go'); },
	remember: async (_event: { request: Request }): Promise<{ receipt: string }> => { throw new Error('skgo: action implemented in Go'); },
	remote: async (_event: { request: Request }): Promise<{ receipt: string }> => { throw new Error('skgo: action implemented in Go'); },
	save: async (_event: { request: Request }): Promise<{ receipt: string; price: Money } | import('@sveltejs/kit').ActionFailure<{ name: string; email: string; biography: string; emailError: string }>> => { throw new Error('skgo: action implemented in Go'); },
	signIn: async (_event: { request: Request }): Promise<void> => { throw new Error('skgo: action implemented in Go'); },
	unavailable: async (_event: { request: Request }): Promise<void> => { throw new Error('skgo: action implemented in Go'); },
	upload: async (_event: { request: Request }): Promise<{ filename: string; bytes: number; sha256: string; interests: Array<string>; submitter: string; price: Money }> => { throw new Error('skgo: action implemented in Go'); },
};

===== BEGIN EXCERPT origin: example/web/src/routes/todos/types.ts lines 1-33 =====
// Code generated by polytype. DO NOT EDIT.

/**
 * Rename is the argument of the renameTodo command.
 */
export type Rename = {
  /**
   * ID names the todo to change.
   */
  "id": string;
  /**
   * Text is its new text.
   */
  "text": string;
};

/**
 * Retitle is the argument of the retitleTodo command.
 */
export type Retitle = {
  /**
   * ID names the todo to change.
   */
  "id": string;
  /**
   * Text is its new text.
   */
  "text": string;
  /**
   * RefreshID names the getTodo the command will refresh afterwards. A real app would not take this from the caller — it would refresh what it knows it changed — but naming it here is what lets the page ask for a refresh of a todo other than the one it just wrote, which is the difference between "the refresh worked" and "the refresh went where its argument said".
   */
  "refreshId": string;
};
===== END EXCERPT =====
